title: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.37859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. translated_title: Seq@K：在序列反馈下评估语言模型
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体与以往的智能系统有着根本性的不同，它们能够从上下文中的自然语言进行学习。这一能力使智能体能够根据反馈迭代地改进其答案，这是现代智能体工作流程中一种普遍的运行模式。然而，社区目前主要通过Pass@1或Pass@K等指标对模型进行排名，这些指标无法捕捉模型如何利用先前尝试的反馈。我们提出了Seq@K，这是一种自然的评估协议，用于衡量模型能否在K次顺序尝试内解决问题，并在每次失败后提供反馈。与考察长程规划的多轮智能体基准不同，Seq@K分离并形式化了“从反馈中改进”这一核心能力。我们在7个基准测试和16个前沿模型上对Seq@K进行了评估，结果表明Seq@K揭示了一个实质性不同的模型选择格局：在Seq@K下，(1) 模型排名往往有所不同
tldr: 该论文提出了Seq@K评估协议，用于衡量语言模型在K次顺序尝试中利用失败反馈迭代改进并最终解决问题的能力，揭示了与Pass@K截然不同的模型排名格局。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Seq@K, an evaluation protocol that measures whether language models can solve a problem within K sequential attempts by leveraging feedback from prior failures, revealing a materially different model-ranking landscape compared to Pass@K.
